generation_method: Built-in image-generation style exploration followed by deterministic exact-coordinate reconstruction from the authoritative source and six approved cumulative-layer differences
final_candidate_base: Authoritative V01 source image at the exact original pixel grid
geometric_transform: None; no resampling, crop, warp, camera change or generative geometry used in the final candidate

imagegen_style_exploration.role: Style exploration only; the draft was rejected as the final because generative geometry could not guarantee exact source alignment and its tonal/amber distribution was broader than required.

correction_history: The pre-existing concept sketch was rejected because it showed an unapproved long under-counter glow and could not prove exact source alignment.
The built-in image-generation draft established the desired charcoal/amber language but was not used as final pixels.
Deterministic v2 preserved exact source geometry but was rejected locally because the graphite base was too pale and the wall-wash amber too broad.
Final v3 deepens the graphite tone, reduces wall-wash and shelf amber, preserves counter hierarchy and strengthens only the deliberately subtle approved under-seater mapping.
